body:
Manual GUI test passed on 2026-11-20.

On `O4 Cam Plate master`, I selected several edges for 2D Chamfer and generated the operation. The viewport showed the expected toolpath on the selected edges. The test did not require a closed loop.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4e22c8dbe915bfa9131486395c4237898532370d -->
Review at head 4e22c8dbe. Read, not built: the PR is from a fork, so its code does not run on the maintainer's runners, and no local build slot was free.

The change reads well:
- `chamfer_open_runs` validates the parameters first, refuses an empty selection, a non-finite corner depth, a chain with no model wall at the programmed depth, and a collapsed segment. Each refusal says what to do. The material side comes from a model read at the two chamfer heights, so climb does not depend on the stored edge direction. Provenance is in the file header.
- The selection wiring adds `Chamfer2D` beside Contour and PlasmaProfile for open runs (#670 pattern). No new command, so no MCP tool is owed.
- The pinning tests cover one edge, connected edges as one run, separate chains as separate passes, and no credit for an unselected edge. File sizes obey the 400-line rule. `docs/decisions/2988-chamfer-open-edge-chains.md` is in the PR. No snapshot PNG is touched.
- The red heavy step you report is not yours: on a platform outside the three pins, `bore_path_matches` still uses the pre-solidcore fallback band, so the same step is red on plain main. I filed #3085 for it.

One requested change:
- The three new refusal branches have no pinning test. Add a test for each: a run with a collapsed segment, an open edge with no model wall at the chamfer depth, and picks that are open runs under Boundary settings that shape an area. Assert the refusal and the message name. This is safety-floor code, so each refusal needs its proof.

Labels are not changed by this review.
Review fix in progress. I will add tests for all three open-chain refusal branches and rerun the focused gate.

Addressed the review at `2fbe6f2fb`.

I added three focused tests. They cover a collapsed segment, no model wall at the chamfer depth, and open runs with area-shaping Boundary settings. The first two now reach explicit chamfer refusal branches. The Boundary refusal now runs before the generic unsupported-area result.

Results:
- Motion tests: 12 passed.
- App tests: 5 passed.
- Clippy: passed.
- Quick gate: 236 of 236 steps passed.
- Heavy gate: 235 of 236 steps passed. The same unrelated `pocket3d_hsm` failure reproduces on unchanged `origin/main` and is tracked in #3085.

The PR is ready for a second review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2fbe6f2fbb33d3be8181ae6097766f2b1415c94e -->
Review at head 2fbe6f2fb. Read, not built: the PR is from a fork, so its code does not run on the maintainer's runners, and no local build slot was free. The only commit since the reviewed head 4e22c8dbe is 2fbe6f2fb, and it answers the one requested change:

- Collapsed segment: `chamfer_open_runs` now checks every segment pair before use, with a finite and 1e-9 length test, and the refusal names the remedy (re-pick the edge). Pinned by `an_open_chamfer_with_a_collapsed_segment_refuses_by_name`.
- No model wall: pinned by `an_open_chamfer_without_a_model_wall_refuses_by_name` (the refusal text predates this commit; the proof did not).
- Open runs under Boundary settings that shape an area: the refusal moved from the contour arm to the top of `run_job_arms`, where it gates before the arm consumes the selection - that was the door that did not open. Pinned by `open_chamfer_runs_with_boundary_area_settings_refuse_by_name`.

I traced the moved check: it fires only for Chamfer2D with a selection whose picks are open runs with no loops, and the earlier `.take()` paths belong to other kinds, so `contour_sel` is still present at the gate. The refusal message is unchanged. File sizes obey the rule for the touched code; `generate.rs` is pre-existing over 400 lines and this commit adds 12.

Clean. One gap for the record: the push carries no gate report for the quick gate at 2fbe6f2fb. Please post the quick-gate result for this head (or state it in the body) - the change is safety-floor code, and the merge batch reads it.

Labels: merge-ready set; the merge decision for this floor work rides with the maintainer's second read.

Merged main to resolve conflicts.

Kept both sides in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`, and `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`.

The result keeps the 2D Chamfer open-chain selection and its refusal. It also keeps main's sketch, slot, wire, and `chamfer_wall_lean` logic.

Targeted results:
- `motion/chamfer_circular`: 12 passed.
- `app/chamfer_open_edges`: 5 passed.
- `app/chamfer_modelled_edge`: 7 passed.
- Clippy for `camcraft-motion` and `camcraft-app`: passed.

The broad quick gate passed 1,076 steps. It failed 10 unrelated steps because of local CRLF fixture mismatches and UI access violations. The touched Chamfer suites passed. The merged main commit had a green post-merge batch gate.

`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3059 --reviewed 2fbe6f2fbb33d3be8181ae6097766f2b1415c94e` reports DELTA for merge commit `7f948e282`.

Ready for a re-check (`/resolve-conflicts check`).
Label `conflicts` removed: this PR is MERGEABLE with current main. The review of record is at head 2fbe6f2fb (2026-11-21); the current head 7f948e2826 gets a review when the PR is flagged ready.

Addressed: the missing quick-gate report and the conflict refresh.

Merged `upstream/main` at `db3bb1f7f`. The new head is `c1b0caaa6af2f97bdfc5b3ffae0a442d1d001cf0`.
The four operation matches keep both `Chamfer2D` and `WaterjetProfile`. The existing refusal checks remain.

Evidence:

- Quick gate: 308 of 308 steps passed in 39 minutes.
- Clippy: passed for `camcraft-motion` and `camcraft-app`, with all targets and warnings denied.
- `chamfer_circular`: 12 passed, including both motion refusal pins.
- `chamfer_modelled_edge`: 7 passed. `chamfer_open_edges`: 5 passed, including the Boundary refusal pin.
- Mutation: removing `Chamfer2D` from the four matches made all five `chamfer_open_edges` tests fail. Restoring the source made all five pass.
- Catalog: 39 passed, 4 ignored. Adaptive and edge-work catalog suites each passed. `golden_cl` passed all 34 tests; `solid_law_goldens` passed all 7 tests.
- No recorded program changed. The quick gate passed the touched suites, including Waterjet coverage.
- Heavy gate: 99 of 99 steps passed in 45.1 minutes. No step failed or stalled. Four expected-red controls passed; seven unreached kernel steps were skipped.
- Light lane: 6 of 6 steps passed in 1.4 minutes.

Quick and heavy gates used `db3bb1f7f3c47cf3561a8e9534f4f2cde260cba8`, current when verification started. Upstream moved to `940cc5d0ee8f2e5b8024bd5389aaefba5682751a` during verification. The latest-main merge simulation passed. Full validation against that newer snapshot did not run. The tested head is preserved.

Thank you, @paulrobin. You are welcome to continue work on this PR.

Ready for a re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c1b0caaa6af2f97bdfc5b3ffae0a442d1d001cf0 -->
Clean. No blocking findings. The PR is MERGEABLE.

This is a safety-tier re-review. I read the complete eight-file diff and both conflict resolutions. I checked the laws from upstream main.

### Earlier findings

- Collapsed segment refusal: fixed in `2fbe6f2fb`. `an_open_chamfer_with_a_collapsed_segment_refuses_by_name` passed. Its mutation failed at the expected assertion.
- Missing model wall refusal: fixed in `2fbe6f2fb`. `an_open_chamfer_without_a_model_wall_refuses_by_name` passed. Its mutation failed at the expected assertion.
- Open runs with Boundary area settings: fixed in `2fbe6f2fb`. `open_chamfer_runs_with_boundary_area_settings_refuse_by_name` passed.
- Missing quick-gate report: fixed. The body and the [Addressed comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3059#issuecomment-7119562246) name this head and its results. My local quick gate also passed.
- Conflict refresh: fixed in `c1b0caaa6`. All four selection matches retain `Chamfer2D` and `WaterjetProfile`. The trial merge succeeded. The Waterjet regression suites passed.

### Code checks

- Open chains keep their selected endpoints. Entry and exit use the air side. Each chain declares one edge break.
- The collapsed-segment check runs before point deduplication. The wall check refuses an unsupported open ride.
- The tool, cone, reach, verification, and post checks remain in use. The unselected-edge test still detects a gouge.
- No dependency, process file, importer, fixture, UI file, or snapshot PNG changed. No new command needs an MCP tool.
- Goldens moved: none. No recorded `.nc` or `.cl` program changed in the PR. The body states this.

### Local build and tests

PR head: `c1b0caaa6af2f97bdfc5b3ffae0a442d1d001cf0`.
Tested upstream base: `940cc5d0ee8f2e5b8024bd5389aaefba5682751a`.
Trial merge: `9756088f81ceda4d96007a59eafaca7da6ca42b9`. Its first parent is the PR head.

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3059`. No GitHub runner ran.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 308 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. 3,044 tests passed; 99 ignored. 43.1 minutes. |
| Clippy, motion and app, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed. |
| `chamfer_circular` | 12 passed. |
| `chamfer_open_edges` | 5 passed. |
| `chamfer_modelled_edge` | 7 passed. |
| `chamfer_partly_bevelled` | 2 passed. |
| `setup_align_chamfer` | 2 passed. |
| `example_catalog` | 39 passed; 4 ignored. |
| `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed. |
| `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed. |
| `golden_cl` | 34 passed. |
| `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed. |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps passed; 11 tests passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 99 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. 36.6 minutes. |

The heavy gate checked four expected-red controls: three for #1950 and one for #2849. Each failed as specified. Seven unreached kernel steps were skipped. The full `finish3d` heavy suite passed all 33 tests. All six shared-face finishing bands passed.

I ran the heavy gate again because upstream changed finishing motion after the author's tested base. These results apply to the exact trial merge above. The shared `upstream/main` ref advanced during validation; that did not change the tested tree.

### Extra suites run

- `mcp_waterjet`: 1 passed.
- `waterjet_machine`: 13 passed.
- `waterjet_profile`: 6 passed.
- The quick gate ran the three catalog suites and both golden suites listed above.
- No changed fixture or importer requires the extra STEP suites.

### Mutations

1. Removed the segment validation before deduplication. The collapsed-segment test failed at its refusal assertion: red.
2. Replaced the missing-wall refusal with a default side. The missing-wall test failed at its refusal assertion: red.

After exact source restoration, all 12 `chamfer_circular` tests passed: green. Both mutations stayed in the throwaway review worktree. The final tracked tree is clean. No review evidence was committed or pushed.

Requested changes: none. The contributor's draft state stays as set by the author. The review worktree stays in place to keep its build artifacts.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Needs changes before merge. Two heavy steps fail against newer upstream main. Both failures also occur on unchanged main.

This is a safety-tier re-review. I read the complete eight-file diff and the conflict resolutions. I used the current upstream AGENTS.md.

The [clean review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3059#issuecomment-7121244674) appeared after this run's initial skip check. It used base `940cc5d0ee8f2e5b8024bd5389aaefba5682751a`. This run uses newer base `cd0222d9cceb5e6f831a13071b93f1d083c3f10e`. The two new blockers below arise with the newer main. They are not defects attributed to the Chamfer change.

### Earlier findings

- Collapsed segment refusal: fixed in `2fbe6f2fb`. Its named test passed. Removal of the guard made that test fail.
- Missing model wall refusal: fixed in `2fbe6f2fb`. Its named test passed. Replacement of the refusal with a default side made that test fail.
- Open runs with Boundary area settings: fixed in `2fbe6f2fb`. `open_chamfer_runs_with_boundary_area_settings_refuse_by_name` passed.
- Missing quick-gate report: fixed. The body and the [Addressed comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3059#issuecomment-7119562246) report this head. The local quick gate also passed.
- Conflict refresh: fixed in `c1b0caaa6`. All four selection matches retain `Chamfer2D` and `WaterjetProfile`. The local trial merge succeeded.
- The latest clean review had no requested code change. I found no new blocker in the PR's code changes.

### NEW blockers from newer main

1. `crates/app/tests/flute_reach.rs:102` — `a_ten_mm_flute_names_its_cause_before_the_rapid_findings` fails. It expects 3 rapid findings and gets 12. Newer main changes the counted warning from `RapidInStock` to `RapidInPart`, but retains the count of 3. The earlier review's base did not contain that change. The exact failure also occurs on unchanged main `cd0222d9c`.
2. `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:79` — `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` fails. The Linux mesh pin expects 6,228 facets and gets 5,232. Newer main changes the solidcore revision after the earlier review's base. The exact failure also occurs on unchanged main `cd0222d9c`.

A maintainer must resolve these failures on main. Verify the mesh and warning changes before changing their assertions. Then run the failed steps on the merged result. The all-green review rule prevents a clean verdict while these steps fail.

### Local build and tests

PR head: `c1b0caaa6af2f97bdfc5b3ffae0a442d1d001cf0`.
Upstream base: `cd0222d9cceb5e6f831a13071b93f1d083c3f10e`.
Trial merge: `6ed42bee4abd8ca5b7d15e53bbd88f60ff1694df`.
The first parent of the trial merge is the PR head.

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3059`, in the foreground. No GitHub runner ran.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 308 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. 3,054 tests passed; 101 ignored. 51.4 minutes. |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps passed; 11 tests passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. 12.5 minutes. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 99 of 101 steps passed; 2 failed; 0 stalled. 42.3 minutes. |
| `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. |
| `chamfer_circular` | 12 passed. |
| `chamfer_modelled_edge` | 7 passed. |
| `chamfer_open_edges` | 5 passed. |

All four expected-red controls matched their specified failures. Seven unreached kernel steps were excluded. All six shared-face finishing bands passed.

I also ran these tests on unchanged upstream commit `cd0222d9cceb5e6f831a13071b93f1d083c3f10e`:

```text
cargo test --release -j 16 -p camcraft-app --test flute_reach a_ten_mm_flute_names_its_cause_before_the_rapid_findings -- --ignored --exact
FAILED at flute_reach.rs:102: left 12, right 3

cargo test --release -j 16 -p camcraft-app --test pocket3d_hsm the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean -- --ignored --exact
FAILED at pocket3d_hsm.rs:79: left 5232, right 6228
```

### Extra suites run

The quick gate ran these suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 39 passed; 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed.
- `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed.

The PR changes no fixture, importer, or STEP file. The extra importer and fixture selection rules require no additional suite.

### Mutations

1. Disabled segment validation before point deduplication. `an_open_chamfer_with_a_collapsed_segment_refuses_by_name` failed at its refusal assertion: red.
2. Replaced the missing-wall refusal with a default side. `an_open_chamfer_without_a_model_wall_refuses_by_name` failed at its refusal assertion: red.

After exact source restoration, all 12 `chamfer_circular` tests and all 5 `chamfer_open_edges` tests passed: green. The tracked worktree is clean.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed in the PR. No UI file changed, so before and after screenshots do not apply. No dependency or process file changed in the PR.

Review state: `needs-rework` under the all-green rule. I did not change the labels, draft state, title, or PR code, as requested. The worktree and branch remain in place. No review evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
